# BuzzFeed

> > BuzzFeed delivers viral news, celebrity gossip, entertainment trends, and political commentary with a focus on social media-driven stories and pop culture moments.

BuzzFeed covers breaking celebrity news, political controversies, entertainment industry trends, and viral social media moments. The site features contributors including Matt Stopera, Mychal Thompson, Natasha Jokic, Tanishtha Kotian, and Ellen Durney, with extensive coverage of figures like Donald Trump, Katherine Heigl, and Jake Paul.

## Key Topics

- Celebrity controversies and gossip
- Political backlash and presidential behavior
- Paris Fashion Week and celebrity style
- Entertainment industry trends
- Viral social media moments
- Political merchandise and fundraising
- Romance tropes and BookTok culture
- Epstein deposition coverage
- Celebrity relationship rumors
- Fashion and appearance criticism
- Trump administration news
- Vertical dramas and mobile content
- Award shows and film criticism
- Celebrity political appearances
